executive_summary: Build failed during test compilation with 90 errors. Primary issues include type mismatches between TaskStatus/TaskPriority enums and String types, missing methods in DTO classes (setVersion, setPage, setLast, getSuccessCount, etc.), method signature mismatches in TaskService.getUserTasks(), and ErrorResponse type conflicts between packages. These errors indicate a significant refactoring or API change that broke test compatibility.

errors.message: Incompatible types: TaskStatus/TaskPriority enums cannot be converted to String (26 occurrences)
errors.root_cause: Test code is attempting to assign TaskStatus and TaskPriority enum values directly to String fields, indicating the DTO or entity model changed from String to enum types but tests were not updated.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all test files to use TaskStatus.name() and TaskPriority.name() when String values are needed, or change the setter calls to accept enum types directly. Example: change .setStatus(TaskStatus.PENDING) to .setStatus(TaskStatus.PENDING.name()) if the field expects String.

errors.message: Cannot find symbol: setVersion, setPage, setLast, setSuccessCount, setFailureCount, setErrors methods
errors.root_cause: DTO classes (TaskResponse, PagedTaskResponse, BulkTaskResponse) were refactored to use builder pattern or immutable design, removing setter methods that tests depend on.
errors.fix_recommendation: Refactor test code to use builder pattern or constructor-based initialization for DTOs. Example: replace response.setVersion(1L) with TaskResponse.builder().version(1L).build() or use appropriate factory methods.

errors.message: Method getUserTasks signature mismatch: required (Long, Pageable) but found (Long, int, int, String)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.getUserTasks() method signature was changed to accept Pageable object instead of individual pagination parameters (page, size, sort), but test code still uses old signature.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all test calls to TaskService.getUserTasks() to use Spring's PageRequest.of(page, size, Sort.by(sortField)). Example: change taskService.getUserTasks(userId, 0, 10, 'createdAt') to taskService.getUserTasks(userId, PageRequest.of(0, 10, Sort.by('createdAt'))).

errors.root_cause: BulkTaskError inner class was removed or relocated from BulkTaskResponse, breaking test code that references it.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update test code to use the new error representation structure in BulkTaskResponse. If BulkTaskError was moved to a separate class, add the appropriate import. If it was replaced with a different structure, refactor tests accordingly.

errors.message: Incompatible types: ResponseEntity<com.myproject.exceptions.ErrorResponse> cannot be converted to ResponseEntity<com.myproject.models.dtos.ErrorResponse> (11 occurrences)
errors.root_cause: ErrorResponse class exists in two packages (exceptions and models.dtos) causing type conflicts. GlobalExceptionHandler likely returns exceptions.ErrorResponse but tests expect models.dtos.ErrorResponse.
errors.fix_recommendation: Consolidate ErrorResponse to a single package location. Remove duplicate class and update all imports across the codebase to use the canonical ErrorResponse location. Recommended location: com.myproject.models.dtos.ErrorResponse.

errors.message: Cannot find symbol: handleConcurrentCreation and handlePerformanceThreshold methods
errors.root_cause: Exception handler methods for ConcurrentTaskCreationException and PerformanceThresholdExceededException were removed from GlobalExceptionHandler but tests still reference them.
errors.fix_recommendation: Either restore the missing exception handler methods in GlobalExceptionHandler or remove the corresponding test methods. If these exceptions are no longer used, clean up the test file and remove ConcurrentTaskCreationException and PerformanceThresholdExceededException classes.

summary: 6 grouped compilation error categories found affecting 90 individual compilation failures
